node.title: rel2abs of a path with env
node.author: ovedpo15
node.doctext:
Hi Monks!
Next to my previous question, I have another corner case. I moved to use Path::Tiny module (by using path($path)->absolute) but I noticed that it does not resolve paths with env. For example: /a/b/c/$USER /a/b/c/${USER} Is it possible to suggest a way to get the absolute path of it? How can I resolve the env without doing it manually?
